decisions.reason: This cleaning soap is a close extension of the firm's wood-floor expertise and after moving to its own page in 2024 it looks like a support product the firm can readily refine and cross-sell.
Maintenance oil fits the firm's existing knowledge of wooden floor performance and after two years on the website it is more likely to be adjusted within the range than withdrawn outright.

A care line for oiled wood floors is highly related to the firm's core flooring and surface-treatment capabilities, and the dedicated 2024 page suggests the firm sees enough value to keep developing it.
Moisture-protection underlay is a system accessory that matches the firm's installation know-how, so despite being less central than flooring itself it likely stays as part of a complete offer.

High-density underlay foam is somewhat more commodity-like and less rooted in the firm's distinctive wood-processing knowledge, but it still complements the flooring system and is more likely to be retained than dropped.
Oak parquet is directly in the firm's core knowledge base and manufacturing competence, making it the kind of product the firm is best able to improve, market, and keep in its portfolio.
